reasoning_content: The jwt login returned 400 now (probably because password quoting). Earlier it returned 200 with proper token. Let me re-run just that.

action.command:
CADDY_IP=$(docker inspect -f '{{range .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{.IPAddress}}{{end}}' qonnectra_caddy_dev)
cat > /tmp/login.sh <<'EOF'
curl -sk --resolve api.localhost:443:$CADDY_IP -X POST https://api.localhost/api/v1/auth/login/ \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-CSRFToken: x" -H "Referer: https://api.localhost/" \
  -d '{"username":"admin","password":"AdminLocalPassw0rd!"}' -w "\nHTTP=%{http_code}\n"
EOF
docker run --rm --network qonnectra_network_dev -e CADDY_IP=$CADDY_IP -v /tmp/login.sh:/login.sh curlimages/curl:latest sh -c 'CADDY_IP='"$CADDY_IP"' sh /login.sh' 2>&1 | tail -3
